hypotheses.question: Does documentation coverage correlate with lower defect density?
hypotheses.hypothesis: Modules with >50% documentation coverage have fewer defects
hypotheses.prediction: Documented modules will show higher test coverage
hypotheses.experiment: Compare test counts between documented and undocumented modules
hypotheses.meta_analysis: Aggregating across all iterations for statistical power

hypotheses.question: Does import density predict cyclomatic complexity?
hypotheses.hypothesis: Files with >10 imports have proportionally higher complexity
hypotheses.prediction: High-import files will have more conditionals and loops
hypotheses.experiment: Correlate import count with if/for/while node counts

hypotheses.question: Do async files have fewer lines on average?

hypotheses.prediction: Async files will be smaller than synchronous equivalents
hypotheses.experiment: Compare line counts of async vs non-async files
hypotheses.meta_analysis: Tracking async adoption trend across iterations
